title: Mountain tubing
body: Kauai day on the water — mountain tubing through the ditches and tunnels. Cool shade, muddy boots, big grins.

title: Abalone dinner
body: Back on the Big Island. Big Island Abalone for dinner — the tank-to-table kind of night.

title: Hilton Waikoloa
body: Hilton Waikoloa Village for several nights — lagoon paths, heat, and slow mornings before the Oahu stretch.

title: Royal Hawaiian
body: Checked into the Royal Hawaiian on Waikiki. Pink walls, beach out front, and a week to wander.

title: Pearl Harbor
body: Out to Pearl Harbor and the USS Arizona Memorial — quiet water, white marble, names in rows.

title: Maui Brewing
body: Maui Brewing in Waikiki for a pint and whatever was on the board. Easy walk from the hotel stretch.
